observation.command: grep -iE "error|exception|fatal" /tmp/prod_verify.log | head -5; echo "=== log status ==="; head -4 /tmp/prod_verify.log; echo "=== stop prod verify server ==="; kill $(cat /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; rm -f /workspace/tmp/pids/prod_verify.pid; ps aux | grep "puma 5.6.8" | grep -v grep; echo "=== dev server still alive ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dev /: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
